instruction: Open /home/user/Desktop/base.step, /home/user/Desktop/cap.step, /home/user/Desktop/rib1.step, /home/user/Desktop/rib2.step in BRL-CAD. Use BRL-CAD to read /home/user/Desktop/base.step, /home/user/Desktop/rib1.step, /home/user/Desktop/rib2.step, and /home/user/Desktop/cap.step. Use the base as a 120 x 60 x 10 mm plate. Place the two 8 x 50 x 30 mm ribs vertically on the base with rib centers at X=30 mm and X=90 mm and Y=30 mm. Place the 110 x 50 x 8 mm cap centered on top of both ribs so its bottom face contacts the rib top faces. Fuse all four solids. Cut a through hole of diameter 12 mm along Z through the cap center and whole model. Save the completed STL mesh as /home/user/Desktop/out.stl. [Software] Run `mged` from a terminal (use the full path if it is not on PATH).
